title: QUIC server-side resumption ticket issuance work item
summary: Add the first opt-in managed server path for emitting TLS 1.3 NewSessionTicket bytes over the QUIC 1-RTT CRYPTO seam.
planned_changes:
- Add a canonical CRT requirement for opt-in server NewSessionTicket issuance.
- Keep issuance internal to the managed server/harness path so the public server options surface does not grow.
- Add a 1-RTT CRYPTO egress buffer and runtime flush path for post-handshake TLS bytes.
- Wire the interop harness resumption server profile to enable ticket issuance without changing the blocked resumption inventory classification.
- Add focused positive, negative, and fuzz-shaped requirement-home proof.
verification_plan: Run the focused `REQ_QUIC_CRT_0150` requirement-home tests, regenerate QUIC requirement coverage triage, validate canonical SpecTrace JSON with the core profile, and run `git diff --check`.
completion_notes: The managed server can now opt in to emitting one bounded TLS 1.3 NewSessionTicket after peer Finished verification and 1-RTT key availability. The ticket is published through the 1-RTT CRYPTO seam and can be flushed as protected application data when an active path exists. PSK cache sharing, binder validation, resumed ServerHello selection, and PSK-DHE derivation remain blocked follow-on work.
